beats.speaker: lead
lines: Why is the printer screaming?
The printer has started printing my search history.

beats.speaker: rival
lines: It saw your forecast.
Finally. Some useful research.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: I clicked print once! ONCE!
Unplug it before page seventeen!

beats.speaker: principal
lines: Nobody expense another forest!
Why does page seventeen have my name on it?

beats.speaker: rival
lines: The printer is our most productive employee.
Promote the printer. It has receipts.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: I am a financial genius!
Green! Somebody get my good angle!

beats.speaker: rival
lines: You made twelve cents.
Your entire position is four dollars.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: Twelve cents more than your personality!
Four dollars with a VISION!

beats.speaker: principal
lines: I already ordered the company yacht!
Excellent. Update my biography immediately.

beats.speaker: rival
lines: The yacht is an inflatable pool toy.
Your biography still says unpaid internship.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: Who copied my strategy?
Someone moved my stop loss!

beats.speaker: rival
lines: Nobody. We like having money.
It was on a sticky note.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: You are literally in my spreadsheet!
That was institutional research!

beats.speaker: principal
lines: Can you two lose quietly?
We are a family. An expensive, broken family.

beats.speaker: rival
lines: I changed your title to senior liability.
I put it back. Under the coffee stain.

beats.speaker: principal
lines: Surprise audit. Look employed.
Everyone close whatever that tab is.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: I am on a very important call.
This is a proprietary forecasting tool.

beats.speaker: rival
lines: That phone is not plugged in.
That is a sandwich delivery website.

beats.speaker: principal
lines: Then why is it our best performing desk?
Show me the research behind that sandwich.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: Zero losses. Perfect execution.
Strong fundamentals. Excellent liquidity. Extra sauce.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: My screen has stopped losing money!
Everything froze. Are we rich now?

beats.speaker: rival
lines: The internet is down.
No. The numbers just stopped moving.

beats.speaker: principal
lines: Finally. A working risk management system.
Freeze them higher next time.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: IT says turn the company off and on.
Support wants to speak to the adult in charge.

beats.speaker: principal
lines: Tell them we tried that with the last boss.
Tell them we are still recruiting.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: The holders are calling! All of them!
Why are all twelve phones ringing?

beats.speaker: rival
lines: Tell them the boss is in a meeting.
I gave the office number to my mother.

beats.speaker: principal
lines: I am under a desk. That counts.
Your mother has asked for a quarterly report.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: They want to speak to the manager of the chart.
She says our curtains look cheap.

beats.speaker: rival
lines: Put the chart on hold.
That is the most accurate analysis today.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: Nobody move! The coffee is going!
I have liquidated the keyboard!

beats.speaker: rival
lines: Save the keyboard! It knows our passwords!
That is not what liquidity means!

beats.speaker: principal
lines: That coffee cost more than your position!
Who approved beverages near our only asset?

beats.speaker: lead
lines: Caught it! Absolutely elite risk management!
Good news. The spreadsheet smells incredible.

beats.speaker: rival
lines: You saved the cup and drowned the mouse.
Bad news. It now forecasts cappuccino.

beats.speaker: principal
lines: Team! We are disrupting finance!
Gather round. I have discovered leadership.

beats.speaker: lead
lines: We have disrupted lunch three times.
Is it another podcast?

beats.speaker: principal
lines: Think bigger! Where do you see yourselves?
Success is ninety percent showing up!

beats.speaker: rival
lines: At a company with a fire exit.
Then why do you arrive at eleven?

beats.speaker: principal
lines: Excellent. An ambitious exit strategy.
The other ten percent is delegation.
